avatars.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game avatar sprite for a browser Gomoku game.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY the pixel-art STYLE reference (three small football sprites); Image 2 is the green straw-haired character SUBJECT reference; Image 3 is the exposed-muscle titan SUBJECT reference; Image 4 is the gray four-armed bodybuilder SUBJECT reference. These are references, not edit targets.
Create exactly ONE character sprite, no sheet and no other characters. Match the charming old handheld RPG / football sprite pixel-art treatment in Image 1: crisp visible square pixels, limited palette, black/dark single-pixel outline, compact chibi head-to-body proportions about 2.5 heads tall, tiny eyes, careful 2-3 tone pixel shading. This is real pixel art, not smooth vector, not high-resolution painting with a pixel filter. Design on a consistent approximately 64 by 64 logical pixel grid, upscaled with nearest-neighbor crisp edges.
Composition must match across the three avatars: square fully transparent canvas, full body seen from the front, neutral upright idle standing pose, feet flat and slightly apart, head facing forward, arms relaxed with hands at the sides, no leaning and no action pose. Sprite centered horizontally, head near 8% from top, feet near 92% from top, body occupies roughly 60% of canvas width. Same visual scale as the other characters. Keep all anatomy, hair, hands and feet inside frame with transparent margin. Background must have real alpha transparency. No background objects, no ground, no shadow, no card, no checkerboard baked into image, no text, no letters, no name and no watermark.
Subject: the GREEN character from Image 2 only. Cute small green kappa / turtle-like boy, enormous round dark eyes with white highlights, pale green rounded snout and face, leaf-green limbs, striped green body and webbed hands and feet. Shaggy brown straw-like bob hair. A small cream shoulder cape / towel with a simplified yellow flower motif drapes down the back/side; keep silhouette readable from front. Preserve the recognizable green palette, straw hair and friendly expression. Translate the tall illustration into the exact same compact standing chibi pixel style as Image 1. Do not turn him into a football player.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: replacement transparent pixel-art game avatar.
Input roles:
- Image 1 (tan wrestler with red boots): EDIT TARGET. Keep this character's identity, but redraw it much more simply and make it shorter.
- Image 2 (green straw-haired character): STYLE AND SPRITE SCALE reference.
- Image 3 (red muscle titan): STYLE AND SPRITE SCALE reference.
Return exactly one image: the revised Image 1 character alone.

Primary request: match the coarse, simple, low-resolution pixel-art quality of Images 2 and 3. Image 1 is currently far too detailed and too tall. Redraw the entire sprite on a STRICT 64x64 logical pixel grid, with a character height of ONLY 48-50 logical pixels. All pixels are visibly large square blocks at the same size as the style references. Nearest-neighbor upscale. Absolutely no fine-detail pixels, antialiasing, intricate anatomy, veins, thin muscle striations, smooth gradients or painterly rendering.
Proportions: compact chibi, around 2.2 heads tall, with a bigger simple head, a much shorter torso and SHORT THICK legs. Keep the stocky muscular silhouette through broad shoulders and thick arms, but use only simple broad shapes for chest, arms and thighs. Abdomen should be a tiny flat patch with one or two chunky shadow shapes, not a detailed six-pack. Hands are simple small blocks with minimal fingers. Skin uses only a base tone, ONE shadow tone and ONE highlight tone.
Keep recognizable Kinnikuman features: tan/peach body, pointed head crest, small black forehead "肉" mark simplified to a few pixels, cartoon white eyes, oval pink mouth area with red edge, red wrestling trunks, white wristbands and SHORT red boots with white trim. Exactly two arms and two legs. Simple confident expression.
Pose: perfectly upright FRONT-FACING neutral standing, both arms down at sides, feet slightly apart, same basic idle pose as the two reference sprites.
Composition: same square canvas as the references. The sprite's total visible height is about 76% of the canvas, including the crest. Top at 14%, feet at 90%, plenty of transparent space above. DO NOT stretch the sprite to fill the canvas or use the tall proportions of Image 1. Align the soles with the other references. Keep the head and boots fully inside the frame. Center horizontally.
Background must preserve actual alpha transparency. No background, ground, shadow, text labels, cards, checkerboard baked into the image, extra characters, or watermark. Only the small simplified forehead mark is allowed.
